title: Positions in a Pair Encoding
statement: For binary strings $x,\alpha$, each bit $x_p$ with $p<|x|$ occurs at both positions $2p$ and $2p+1$ of $\langle x,\alpha\rangle$. Positions $2|x|$ and $2|x|+1$ contain $0$ and $1$, respectively, and for every $i\in\mathbb{N}$ the bit at position $2|x|+2+i$ equals $\alpha_i$; out-of-range positions are interpreted as undefined.
